feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Scuffles and fires break out as protesters rally across France, joining students
entry.summary: Demonstrators across France converged with students Saturday to protest rising living costs, as the country's fiscal crisis deepens.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
entry.summary: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.

entry.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
entry.summary: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

entry.title: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
entry.summary:
More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past
are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking truth, accountability and reparations before it's too late.

entry.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
entry.summary: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.

entry.title: Trump promised a swing district blitz. He's going to a lot of very red states
entry.summary: President Trump's midterm travel blitz ahead of Election Day includes several red states he won easily 2 years ago, showing the electoral landscape is more challenging for Republicans.

entry.title: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
entry.summary: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.

entry.title: No Kings draws crowds with focus on early voting
entry.summary: The coalition behind nationwide anti-Trump protests shifted its strategies this weekend to focus on voter turnout. Thousands of people attended rallies, marches and community gatherings all concentrated on early voting in the midterms.

entry.title: Coastal homes burn as hot winds fuel California fires
entry.summary: High winds are fueling a fast-moving fire that has burned homes in Southern California. Flames engulfed expensive coastal properties and prompted thousands to evacuate.

entry.title: How a retired Navajo Nation doctor earned a MacArthur genius grant for public art
entry.summary: Chip Thomas, a retired physician on the Navajo Reservation, is well known for his large photograhpic murals. Now, he's been recognized with a MacArthur "genius" grant.
